changes: Converted to JSON by scripts/build-bond-valence.ts. Entries marked "unchecked" are left out, and for each pair of ions only the first remaining (most reliable) entry is kept. No value is changed.
equation: s = exp((R0 - R) / b), R the bond length; R0 and b in angstrom
